explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/43, second question: if |A| = |B|, can the bound be improved to (1 − c + o(1))C(f(N),2) for some c > 0? The page records Barreto's negative answer, via infinitely many N with sum ≥ (1 − o(1))C(f(N),2). The statement negates ∃ c > 0, ∃ o = o(1), for large N, all equal-sized such A, B satisfy the bound. Quantifier order matches. Faithful.
